name: Absa Group Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | CRON 2026-10-12: H1 2026 column completed from Absa Group Limited unaudited consolidated results for the interim reporting period ended 30 June 2026, the full SENS announcement, figures in R million. Printed consolidated statement of comprehensive income: operating profit before income tax 18 841; taxation expense 4 841; profit for the reporting period 14 000; profit attributable to ordinary equity holders 12 579; basic earnings per ordinary share 1 517.9 cents. The commentary prints operating expenses of R31 393m and a cost to income ratio of 53.4 percent, which reproduces R31 393m on the printed revenue of R58 791m. Operating Expenses is that printed figure. Profit Before Tax is the printed operating profit before income tax. Income Tax is the printed taxation expense. Net Profit is stored as the printed profit attributable to ordinary equity holders of R12 579m, the measure the file own annual columns carry: FY2025 22 214m is the printed profit attributable to ordinary equity holders for that year. The printed profit for the reporting period of R14 000m includes R1 421m attributable to non controlling interests and additional tier 1 capital holders, which the issuer prints separately. Revenue 58 791 and EPS 15.179 were already stored and are unchanged. A bank presents no cost of sales or gross profit line, so those cells stay empty. | CRON 20261108_0515: FY2021 column rebuilt from Absa Group Limited audited summary consolidated financial results for the reporting period ended 31 December 2021 (SENS announcement dated 14 March 2022, absa.africa), R million, group column: total income 85 906, operating expenses 48 610, operating profit before income tax 26 724, taxation expense 7 299, profit for the reporting period 19 425, profit attributable to ordinary equity holders 17 763. Operating expenses and net profit were empty and are now filled. Revenue was carried at 77 342, which reproduces neither printed line for that year (total income 85 906, operating income before operating expenses 77 407), so it is set to the printed total income, the same convention the FY2022 to FY2025 columns follow. Checks: 85 906 less 8 499 impairment losses equals 77 407, the printed operating income before operating expenses; 85 906 less 48 610 equals 37 296, the printed pre-provision profit; 26 724 less 7 299 equals 19 425. Net Profit is stored on the attributable-to-ordinary-equity-holders basis, the convention the stored FY2022 figure of 20 265 already follows. Net finance costs for FY2021 are left empty: Absa reports net interest income rather than a separate net finance cost line and no printed figure was read for that row. Source: https://www.absa.africa/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Full-year-Group-full-SENS-announcement-single-page.pdf
